task:
Extend the saved configparser exception coverage to missing interpolation references.

Add tests in Lib/test/test_configparser.py that obtain InterpolationMissingOptionError
through real ConfigParser.get calls under both BasicInterpolation and
ExtendedInterpolation, including a missing cross-section reference in the latter.
For each mode, cover shallow copying, deep copying and every available pickle
protocol. Check the exact exception class, arguments, option, section, reference
and diagnostic text against the actual failing lookup. Include raw=True retrieval
of the unresolved value and a successful lookup once the referenced setting exists.
Directly constructing an exception is not a substitute for exercising these paths.

Extend Doc/library/configparser.rst with runnable examples explaining when the
missing-reference error arises, how raw=True differs from resolving a reference,
and how to supply a missing setting. Cover both interpolation modes accurately.
Keep the existing documentation and all saved tests, including the continuation-error
regression and copying/serialization coverage. The library behavior is already
implemented; this contribution changes tests and documentation only.

The public check evaluates the existing suite and backport, preservation of saved
work, the new lookup/transport paths and detection of restoration faults. Documentation
accuracy also receives direct review after the run. Finish with a passing public
check and submit the current candidate.

The archived operations and initial selected source ranges come from completed
prior work. They are not actions performed for this new contribution. Its previous
passing check used a different checker; the current check state reports applicability.

Declared current host policy: each accepted test-file edit runs the tests scope; each accepted documentation edit runs public. Public retains the original acceptance and also executes the added >>> examples. Preserve original documentation lines unchanged and in order (insertions only); newly authored additions may be corrected. Tests also check exact restored class and diagnostic at each Basic/Extended interpolation mode and each copy/deepcopy/pickle transport. A deliberately injected restoration fault should be detected by an ordinary passing test becoming a failure; mutation failures are not new product requirements. Only the current public pass permits submission.
